# Bithat Secure Vault — Architecture Repository

This repository is the **official architecture documentation** for the Bithat Secure Vault (BSV): an offline-first, secure-by-default infrastructure asset vault for macOS.

> The historical origin document is preserved at [`ROADMAP.md`](../ROADMAP.md). All architecture is now organized into versioned, cross-referenced RFCs, ADRs, diagrams, and indexes generated from a single registry (`tools/rfc_registry.py`).

## Start Here

- [Architecture Index](./architecture/README.md) — master hub
- [RFC Index](./rfcs/README.md) — all RFCs
- [Architecture Review](./architecture/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md) — gap analysis of the source material
- [Implementation Roadmap](./architecture/implementation-roadmap.md)

## Repository Layout

```text
docs/
  architecture/   indexes, review, roadmap, dependency graph
  rfcs/           RFC-0001 .. RFC-0029 (each with parts + diagrams)
  diagrams/       cross-cutting Mermaid diagrams
  adr/            architecture decision records
  decisions/      decision index
  api/  sdk/      interface & SDK docs
  glossary/       master glossary
  compliance/     compliance mappings
  testing/        verification strategy
  deployment/     release engineering
  operations/     runbooks & incident response
  templates/      reusable RFC/ADR/diagram templates
  images/         binary assets
tools/            registry + generators
```

## Regenerating

```bash
python3 tools/split_roadmap.py      # migrate RFC-0001..0005 parts
python3 tools/generate_docs.py      # render indexes, scaffolds, ADRs
```
